feeds.title: Paul Moore Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about Linux security, the latest news and features and more. Paul Moore has been involved in various Linux platform security efforts since 2004 at Hewlett-Packard, Red Hat, Cisco, and Microsoft. He currently maintains the SELinux, audit, and labeled networking subsystems in the Linux Kernel as well as the libseccomp userspace library.
